nodes.description: Private mapping(address => uint) recording the game number each player last registered in; used by betConditions and canBet to gate participation.
Private mapping(address => uint) flag marking addresses allowed to withdraw the jackpot; set in revealWinner, cleared and consumed in winnerWithdraw.
Private mapping(uint => address) mapping player slot numbers to addresses; written in placeBet and read in revealWinner to pick the winner.
Number of players required to trigger a reveal (initialised to 25); bounds game size and modulates randomness.
Current required stake (0.005 ether initially); enforced in betConditions, changed by changeBet, used as payout amounts.
Count of players in the current round; incremented in placeBet, compared against currentPlayersRequired, reset in revealWinner.
Computed payout amount stored before transfer in winnerWithdraw; value derived from currentBet and currentPlayersRequired.
Block number captured when the round fills; used as the blockhash source for randomness in revealWinner and as the time window anchor.
Monotonic game/round counter; incremented in the constructor and in revealWinner, compared against playerRegistrationStatus.
Address of this contract stored at construction; its balance is checked in changeBetConditions.
Privileged owner address; set to msg.sender in the constructor and updated by transferOwnership, gates onlyOwner functions.
Address of the most recent winner; returned by canBet and updated in revealWinner.
Untrusted caller address; used for owner assignment, registration checks, winner confirmation and as the recipient of both ether transfers.
Constructor: sets contractAddress, currentGame, currentPlayersRequired, owner, currentBet and lastWinner.
Owner-only transfer of ownership to newOwner; emits OwnershipTransferred and writes owner.
External owner-only function updating currentBet, guarded by changeBetConditions (no players, zero contract balance).
Public view returning eligibility status, playerCount snapshot and lastWinner snapshot to the caller.
Payable entry point registering msg.sender for the current game, incrementing playerCount and recording revealBlock when the round is full.
External reveal routine gated by revealConditions; derives winner from blockhash, marks confirmedWinners and transfers currentBet to the caller.
External withdrawal for confirmed winners; clears the flag, computes the jackpot and transfers it to msg.sender.
owner = msg.sender performed in the constructor, granting full control to the deploying account with no ownership handover validation beyond address(0).
msg.sender.transfer(currentBet) inside revealWinner: raw ether sent to an untrusted caller using the gas-limited transfer primitive, external call before any reentrancy guard.
msg.sender.transfer(jackpot) inside winnerWithdraw: raw ether sent to an untrusted caller; state flag is cleared first but no reentrancy guard exists.
Winner selection derived from block.blockhash(revealBlock) and block.number; miner-influenceable and reorg-sensitive randomness used for value distribution.
jackpot = (currentBet * (currentPlayersRequired - 1)) unchecked multiplication/subtraction performed without SafeMath.
Address parameter of transferOwnership that becomes the new owner after the zero-address check.
Unsigned integer parameter of changeBet written directly into the currentBet state variable.
Local eligibility flag in canBet derived from playerRegistrationStatus[msg.sender] versus currentGame.
Local snapshot copy of the playerCount state variable returned by canBet.
Local snapshot copy of the lastWinner state variable returned by canBet.
Local copy of block.number in revealWinner used to test the 255-block window against revealBlock.
Pseudo-random winning slot number derived from blockhash modulo currentPlayersRequired.
Winner address looked up from numberToAddress using _winningNumber; written into confirmedWinners and lastWinner.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the key when reading and writing playerRegistrationStatus in betConditions, placeBet and canBet.
confirmedWinners[msg.sender] gates withdrawal eligibility and is cleared by the caller in winnerWithdraw.
msg.sender is stored into numberToAddress[playerCount] during placeBet, tying slot ownership to the caller.
msg.sender is assigned to the owner state variable in the constructor, giving the caller privileged control.
The constructor consumes msg.sender both for owner and for lastWinner initialisation.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership executes.
changeBet is restricted by onlyOwner, which compares msg.sender against the owner state variable.
betConditions requires playerRegistrationStatus[msg.sender] < currentGame, confirmedWinners[msg.sender] == 0 and msg.value == currentBet before placeBet runs.
revealWinner is an external entry point callable by any msg.sender once revealConditions hold.
winnerWithdrawConditions requires confirmedWinners[msg.sender] == 1, so the caller controls whether the withdrawal path is entered.
The withdrawing caller is the recipient of the jackpot transfer, making the external call target attacker-controlled.
The unsafe owner assignment takes its value directly from the untrusted msg.sender.
msg.sender is the recipient of the currentBet transfer in revealWinner, creating an attacker-controlled external call.
msg.sender is the recipient of the jackpot transfer in winnerWithdraw, creating an attacker-controlled external call.
The caller who triggers winnerWithdraw ultimately receives the unchecked jackpot arithmetic result.
The constructor performs the owner = msg.sender assignment represented by unsafe_owner_assignment.
The constructor initialises currentPlayersRequired to 25.
The constructor initialises currentBet to 0.005 ether.
The constructor increments currentGame to start the first round.
The constructor writes the owner state variable with the deployer address.
The constructor initialises lastWinner to the deployer.
transferOwnership rewrites the owner state variable, changing who passes onlyOwner.
changeBet writes the new stake into the currentBet state variable.
canBet assigns the eligibility result to the _status local variable that is returned.
canBet returns the _playerCount snapshot local variable.
canBet returns the _lastWinner snapshot local variable.
placeBet records the caller address into numberToAddress keyed by the incremented playerCount.
placeBet increments the playerCount state variable for each accepted bet.
placeBet stores block.number into revealBlock when the round reaches currentPlayersRequired.
Filling the round in placeBet is the precondition that enables the externally invoked revealWinner to proceed.
revealWinner sets confirmedWinners[_winningAddress] = 1, minting a withdrawal right for an attacker-influenced address.
revealWinner updates the lastWinner state variable to the selected address.
revealWinner reads block.number into the _thisBlock local variable for the 255-block window check.
winnerWithdraw performs the jackpot transfer represented by unsafe_transfer_jackpot.
The unsafe owner assignment writes directly into the owner state variable.
The currentBet state variable supplies the amount transferred to the caller in revealWinner.
The jackpot state variable supplies the amount transferred to the caller in winnerWithdraw.
The blockhash-derived weakness determines the _winningNumber local variable used to select the winner.
The unchecked multiplication assigns its result to the jackpot state variable before the payout.
The newOwner parameter is written into the owner state variable without any two-step handover.
newOwner is the sole parameter of transferOwnership and drives the ownership change.
The _newBet parameter is assigned straight into the currentBet state variable.
_newBet is the parameter of changeBet that controls the new required stake.
_status is the eligibility local variable computed and returned by canBet.
_playerCount is a local snapshot created inside canBet.
_lastWinner is a local snapshot created inside canBet.
_thisBlock is compared with the stored revealBlock to decide whether the blockhash-based reveal may execute.
_winningNumber indexes the numberToAddress mapping to resolve the winner.
_winningAddress is written into confirmedWinners, granting a payout right determined by weak randomness.
_winningAddress is stored into the lastWinner state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner is only meaningful as the ownership target of transferOwnership, so it folds into that core function node.
_newBet is only used to set currentBet inside changeBet and adds no independent semantics.
_status is a transient return value computed entirely within canBet.
_playerCount is a local snapshot of a state variable returned by canBet.
_lastWinner is a local snapshot of a state variable returned by canBet.
_thisBlock is a local copy of block.number used only inside revealWinner's time-window check.
_winningNumber is an intermediate randomness result that exists only within revealWinner.
_winningAddress is an intermediate lookup result consumed by revealWinner to set the winner state.
